Key.Original: No AI unit or group found
Key.Chinesesimp: 未发现人工智能单位或团体
Key.Chinese: 未發現人工智能單位或團體

Key.Original: Zone updated - effect will be shown in a few minutes
Key.Chinesesimp: 区域更新-将在下一个航路点有效
Key.Chinese: 區域更新-將在下一個航路點有效

Key.Chinesesimp: 将人工智能分配到区域
Key.Chinese: 將人工智能分配到區域

Key.Original: sync with groups or units and one Create Zone module.
Key.Chinesesimp: 与组或单位和一个创建区域模块同步。
Key.Chinese: 與組或單位和一個創建區域模塊同步。

Key.Original: units will automatically will be assigned to the MCC zone
Key.Chinesesimp: 单位将自动分配到MCC区域
Key.Chinese: 單位將自動分配到MCC區域

Key.Original: Enables spawning random flocks of birds when units get close to trees
Key.Chinesesimp: 当单位靠近树木时，可以随机生成鸟类
Key.Chinese: 當單位靠近樹木時，可以隨機生成鳥類

Key.Chinesesimp: 单位将在建筑物之间移动
Key.Chinese: 單位將在建築物之間移動

Key.Original: Cars will spawn and drive around
Key.Chinesesimp: 汽车会生成并四处行驶
Key.Chinese: 汽車會生成並四處行駛

Key.Original: Parked cars will always be locked
Key.Chinesesimp: 停放的汽车将始终上锁
Key.Chinese: 停放的汽車將始終上鎖

Key.Original: Empty cars will spawn on the road's sides

Key.Chinesesimp: 坏（简易爆炸装置和自杀炸弹袭击者）
Key.Chinese: 壞（簡易爆炸裝置和自殺炸彈襲擊者）

Key.Original: Only specific sides can use this airfield
Key.Chinesesimp: 只有特定派系才能使用该机场
Key.Chinese: 只有特定派系才能使用該機場

Key.Original: Create circles guides to following the landing path
Key.Chinesesimp: 创建圆形参考线以遵循着陆路径
Key.Chinese: 創建圓形參考線以遵循著陸路徑

Key.Original: Place ILS module on each runway's start facing the same direction as the runway
Key.Chinesesimp: 在每条跑道的起点放置ILS模块，面向与跑道相同的方向
Key.Chinese: 在每條跑道的起點放置ILS模塊，面向與跑道相同的方向

Key.Original: Auto balance the number of AI to players
Minimum number of AI per side
Key.Chinesesimp: 每方人工智能的最低数量
Key.Chinese: 每方人工智能的最低數量

Key.Original: Minimum number of AI no matter how many players
Key.Chinesesimp: 无论有多少玩家，AI的最低数量
Key.Chinese: 無論有多少玩家，AI的最低數量

Key.Original: Spawn AI on captured sectors or just at start location
Key.Chinesesimp: 在捕获的区域或仅在开始位置产生人工智能
Key.Chinese: 在捕獲的區域或僅在開始位置產生人工智能

Key.Original: How far AI will look for empty vehicles around the spawn point
Key.Chinesesimp: 人工智能会在生成点周围寻找空车辆多远
Key.Chinese: 人工智能會在生成點周圍尋找空車輛多遠

Key.Original: AI will use roles kits as defined in MCC_loadouts
Key.Chinesesimp: 人工智能将使用MCC_loads中定义的角色套件
Key.Chinese: 人工智能將使用MCC_loads中定義的角色套件

Key.Original: AI will spawn vehicles equals to the enemy vehicles
Key.Chinesesimp: 人工智能将产生与敌方车辆相当的车辆
Key.Chinese: 人工智能將產生與敵方車輛相當的車輛

Key.Original: Spawn AI that will try to conquer enemy sectors in MCC AAS
Key.Chinesesimp: 生成人工智能，试图在MCC AAS中征服敌方区域
Key.Chinese: 生成人工智能，試圖在MCC AAS中征服敵方區域

Key.Original: How many tickets lost every 5 seconds to the loosing side
Key.Chinesesimp: 失去阵营的复活票每五秒失去多少张复活票
Key.Chinese: 失去陣營的復活票每五秒失去多少張復活票

Key.Original: Creates an Advance And Secure mission where objectives can only be captured in a specific order, Sync with a MCC capture zone or a dummy sector module in order they supposed to be captured. Follow the sector description to set up the AAS mission
Key.Chinesesimp: 创建一个行进和营救任务，其中目标只能按照特定顺序捕获，与MCC捕获区或虚拟扇形模块同步，以确定目标被捕获的顺序。按照行业描述设置AAS任务
Key.Chinese: 創建一個行進和營救任務，其中目標只能按照特定順序捕獲，與MCC捕獲區或虛擬扇形模塊同步，以確定目標被捕獲的順序。按照行業描述設置AAS任務

Key.Original: Sync with a MCC capture zone or a dummy sector module in order they supposed to be captured. Follow the sector description to set up the AAS mission
Key.Chinesesimp: 与MCC捕获区或虚拟扇形模块同步，以确定捕获它们的顺序。按照行业描述设置AAS任务
Key.Chinese: 與MCC捕獲區或虛擬扇形模塊同步，以確定捕獲它們的順序。按照行業描述設置AAS任務

Key.Original: Random fires will ignite from explosives and fire fights, the fire will spread according to wind strength and direction
Key.Chinesesimp: 爆炸物和消防会引发随机火灾，火势会根据风力和方向蔓延
Key.Chinese: 爆炸物和消防會引發隨機火災，火勢會根據風力和方向蔓延

Key.Original: Create pre set or custom atmospheres
Key.Chinesesimp: 创建预设或自定义氛围
Key.Chinese: 創建預設或自定義氛圍

Key.Original: Lock or unlock buildings doors in the given radius, locked door can be opened with breaching charges or lockpicking using MCC interaction
Key.Chinesesimp: 锁定或解锁给定半径内的建筑物门，可以通过破坏装置或使用MCC交互进行撬锁打开上锁的门
Key.Chinese: 鎖定或解鎖給定半徑內的建築物門，可以通過破壞裝置或使用MCC交互進行撬鎖打開上鎖的門

Key.Original: Destroy buildings, create random fires and wreck in the given radius
Key.Chinesesimp: 在给定半径内摧毁建筑物、制造随机火灾和残骸
Key.Chinese: 在給定半徑內摧毀建築物、製造隨機火災和殘骸

Key.Original: Sync it with any unit or group to respawn the group when all units in the group dead
Key.Chinesesimp: 当群中所有单位都死亡时，将其与任何单位或群同步以重生群组
Key.Chinese: 當群中所有單位都死亡時，將其與任何單位或群同步以重生群組

Key.Original: How many time can the group respawn
will move the respawn marker to the current position of the unit while the unit is alive, if the unit dead will move the marker to the previous location.
Key.English: will move the respawn marker to the current position of the unit while the unit is alive, if the unit dead will move the marker to the previous location.
Key.Chinese: 单位存活时将重生标记移动到其当前位置，单位死亡后将标记移回之前的位置。
Key.Chinese_Traditional: 單位存活時將重生標記移動到其當前位置，單位死亡後將標記移回之前的位置。

Key.Original: return the amount of indexed positions in a building.
Key.English: return the amount of indexed positions in a building.
Key.Chinese: 返回建筑物中索引位置的数量。
Key.Chinese_Traditional: 返回建築物中索引位置的數量。

Key.Original: returns a unit array consist of all the units from the given function and simulation in format [_cfgclass,_vehicleDisplayName].
Key.English: returns a unit array consist of all the units from the given function and simulation in format [_cfgclass,_vehicleDisplayName].
Key.Chinese: 返回一个单位数组，包含来自给定函数和模拟的所有单位，格式为 [_cfgclass,_vehicleDisplayName]。
Key.Chinese_Traditional: 返回一個單位數組，包含來自給定函數和模擬的所有單位，格式為 [_cfgclass,_vehicleDisplayName]。

Key.Original: Count the number of infantry, vehicles, tank, air, ships in a group.
Key.English: Count the number of infantry, vehicles, tank, air, ships in a group.
Key.Chinese: 计算组中的步兵、车辆、坦克、飞机、船只数量。
Key.Chinese_Traditional: 計算組中的步兵、車輛、坦克、飛機、船隻數量。

Key.Chinese: 在所有客户端上设置时间。
Key.Chinese_Traditional: 在所有客戶端上設置時間。

Key.Original: Sets weather on all clients - skip time by one hour to make the weather change.
Key.English: Sets weather on all clients - skip time by one hour to make the weather change.
Key.Chinese: 在所有客户端上设置天气 - 跳过一小时以使天气变化。
Key.Chinese_Traditional: 在所有客戶端上設置天氣 - 跳過一小時以使天氣變化。

Key.Original: Say sound on 3D on all clients.
Key.English: Say sound on 3D on all clients.
Key.Chinese: 在所有客户端上播放3D声音。
Key.Chinese_Traditional: 在所有客戶端上播放3D聲音。

Key.Original: Broadcast a message on all clients.
Key.English: Broadcast a message on all clients.
Key.Chinese: 在所有客户端上广播消息。
Key.Chinese_Traditional: 在所有客戶端上廣播消息。

Key.Original: Global execute a command on selected clients or server.
Key.English: Global execute a command on selected clients or server.
Key.Chinese: 在选定的客户端或服务器上全局执行命令。
Key.Chinese_Traditional: 在選定的客戶端或伺服器上全局執行命令。

Key.Chinese: 在多人游戏中发送聊天。
Key.Chinese_Traditional: 在多人遊戲中發送聊天。

Key.Original: move an object to a new location.
Key.English: move an object to a new location.

Key.Original: Make a vehicle class item pickable and add variable to it.
Key.English: Make a vehicle class item pickable and add variable to it.
Key.Chinese: 使载具类物品可拾取并为其添加变量。
Key.Chinese_Traditional: 使載具類物品可拾取並為其添加變量。

Key.Original: Create a virtual camera and broadcast a short PiP video to all clients for 15 seconds.
Key.English: Create a virtual camera and broadcast a short PiP video to all clients for 15 seconds.
Key.Chinese: 创建一个虚拟摄像机并向所有客户端广播15秒的画中画视频。
Key.Chinese_Traditional: 創建一個虛擬攝像機並向所有客戶端廣播15秒的畫中畫視頻。

Key.Original: Create a HALO or regular parachute jump for the given unit.
Key.English: Create a HALO or regular parachute jump for the given unit.
Key.Chinese: 为指定单位创建HALO或常规跳伞。
Key.Chinese_Traditional: 為指定單位創建HALO或常規跳傘。

Key.Original: Create a HALO or regular parachute jump for the given units with simulation of running out of an airplane.
Key.English: Create a HALO or regular parachute jump for the given units with simulation of running out of an airplane.
Key.Chinese: 为指定单位创建HALO或常规跳伞，并模拟从飞机跳出的过程。
Key.Chinese_Traditional: 為指定單位創建HALO或常規跳傘，並模擬從飛機跳出的過程。

Key.Original: Handle the paradrop from the unit side.
Key.English: Handle the paradrop from the unit side.

Key.Original: Count the number of infantry, vehicles, tank, air, ships in a group expand.
Key.English: Count the number of infantry, vehicles, tank, air, ships in a group expand.
Key.Chinese: 计算扩展组中的步兵、车辆、坦克、飞机、船只数量。
Key.Chinese_Traditional: 計算擴展組中的步兵、車輛、坦克、飛機、船隻數量。

Key.Original: Create and control AI WP on map.
Key.English: Create and control AI WP on map.
Key.Chinese: 在地图上创建和控制AI路径点。
Key.Chinese_Traditional: 在地圖上創建和控制AI路徑點。

Key.Original: Sync the player with the server.
Key.English: Sync the player with the server.

Key.Original: Takes an array of data about a dynamic object template and creates the objects.
Key.English: Takes an array of data about a dynamic object template and creates the objects.
Key.Chinese: 获取动态对象模板的数据数组并创建对象。
Key.Chinese_Traditional: 獲取動態對象模板的數據數組並創建對象。

Key.Original: Find Road segments leading to an area.
Key.English: Find Road segments leading to an area.
Key.Chinese: 查找通往某个区域的道路段。
Key.Chinese_Traditional: 查找通往某個區域的道路段。

Key.Original: Click and drag on the minimap to make a zone
Key.English: Click and drag on the minimap to make a zone
Key.Chinese: 在小地图上点击并拖拽来创建区域
Key.Chinese_Traditional: 在小地圖上點擊並拖拽來創建區域

Key.Original: Give the selected groups to GAIA control with the selected zone and behavior
Key.English: Give the selected groups to GAIA control with the selected zone and behavior
Key.Chinese: 将选中的组交给GAIA控制，使用选定的区域和行为
Key.Chinese_Traditional: 將選中的組交給GAIA控制，使用選定的區域和行為

Key.Original: Give the selected groups to player's control with the commander console
Key.English: Give the selected groups to player's control with the commander console
Key.Chinese: 将选中的组交给玩家控制，使用指挥官控制台
Key.Chinese_Traditional: 將選中的組交給玩家控制，使用指揮官控制台

Key.Chinese: 打开近距离空中支援菜单
Key.Chinese_Traditional: 打開近距離空中支援菜單

Key.Chinese: 打开简易爆炸装置菜单
Key.Chinese_Traditional: 打開簡易爆炸裝置菜單

Key.Original: Spawn AC-130 (use MCC console to control it)
Key.English: Spawn AC-130 (use MCC console to control it)

Key.Original: Click on map to open BIS Zeus
Key.English: Click on map to open BIS Zeus

Key.Original: Return a Road segments array near positions.
Key.English: Return a Road segments array near positions.
Key.Chinese: 返回位置附近的道路段数组。
Key.Chinese_Traditional: 返回位置附近的道路段數組。

Key.Original: Save MCC's placements in SQM file format and copy it to clipboard.
Key.English: Save MCC's placements in SQM file format and copy it to clipboard.
Key.Chinese: 将MCC的放置保存为SQM文件格式并复制到剪贴板。
Key.Chinese_Traditional: 將MCC的放置保存為SQM文件格式並複製到剪貼板。

Key.Original: Save MCC's 3D editor placements in composition format.
Key.English: Save MCC's 3D editor placements in composition format.
Key.Chinese: 将MCC的3D编辑器放置保存为组合格式。
Key.Chinese_Traditional: 將MCC的3D編輯器放置保存為組合格式。

Key.Original: Filter a string and removes certain characters (_filter).
Key.English: Filter a string and removes certain characters (_filter).
Key.Chinese: 过滤字符串并删除特定字符（_filter）。
Key.Chinese_Traditional: 過濾字符串並刪除特定字符（_filter）。

Key.Original: Get direction integer and return it as a string North, east etc.
Key.English: Get direction integer and return it as a string North, east etc.
Key.Chinese: 获取方向整数并将其返回为字符串（北、东等）。
Key.Chinese_Traditional: 獲取方向整數並將其返回為字符串（北、東等）。

Key.Original: Teleport the player when start location has been found.
Key.English: Teleport the player when start location has been found.
Key.Chinese: 找到起始位置时将玩家传送。
Key.Chinese_Traditional: 找到起始位置時將玩家傳送。

Key.Original: get idkKey and return string with his name.
Key.English: get idkKey and return string with his name.
Key.Chinese: 获取 idkKey 并返回其名称的字符串。
Key.Chinese_Traditional: 獲取 idkKey 並返回其名稱的字符串。

Key.Original: Server Only - create a Logic based briefing.
Key.English: Server Only - create a Logic based briefing.
Key.Chinese: 仅服务器 - 创建基于逻辑的任务简报。
Key.Chinese_Traditional: 僅伺服器 - 創建基於邏輯的任務簡報。

Key.Original: Add the given text to the mission briefing
Key.English: Add the given text to the mission briefing
Key.Chinese: 将给定文本添加到任务简报中
Key.Chinese_Traditional: 將給定文本添加到任務簡報中

Key.Original: Add the given text to the mission's enemy intelligence
Key.English: Add the given text to the mission's enemy intelligence
Key.Chinese: 将给定的文本添加到任务的敌军情报中
Key.Chinese_Traditional: 將給定的文本添加到任務的敵軍情報中

Key.Original: Add the given text to the mission's friendly information
Key.English: Add the given text to the mission's friendly information
Key.Chinese: 将给定的文本添加到任务的友军信息中
Key.Chinese_Traditional: 將給定的文本添加到任務的友軍信息中

Key.Original: Add the given text to the mission overview
Key.English: Add the given text to the mission overview
Key.Chinese: 将给定文本添加到任务概述中
Key.Chinese_Traditional: 將給定文本添加到任務概述中

Key.Original: Add the given text to the mission's special tasks
Key.English: Add the given text to the mission's special tasks
Key.Chinese: 将给定文本添加到任务的特殊任务中
Key.Chinese_Traditional: 將給定文本添加到任務的特殊任務中

Key.Original: Add the given text to the mission's support information
Key.English: Add the given text to the mission's support information
Key.Chinese: 将给定的文本添加到任务的支持信息中
Key.Chinese_Traditional: 將給定的文本添加到任務的支持信息中

Key.Original: According to intel from a local informant
Key.English: According to intel from a local informant

Key.Original: According to info from High Command
Key.English: According to info from High Command
Key.Chinese: 根据最高指挥部的信息
Key.Chinese_Traditional: 根據最高指揮部的信息

Key.Chinese: 在这个区域的某个地方
Key.Chinese_Traditional: 在這個區域的某個地方

Key.Original: presence in the area has been increased
Key.English: presence in the area has been increased
Key.Chinese: 在该地区的存在感有所增加
Key.Chinese_Traditional: 在該地區的存在感有所增加

Key.Original: have established a foothold in the area
Key.English: have established a foothold in the area
Key.Chinese: 已在该地区建立了立足点
Key.Chinese_Traditional: 已在該地區建立了立足點

Key.Original: forces are active in the area
Key.English: forces are active in the area

Key.Original: and they have taken up defensive positions inside buildings.
Key.English: and they have taken up defensive positions inside buildings.
Key.Chinese: ，他们已经在建筑物内建立了防御阵地。
Key.Chinese_Traditional: ，他們已經在建築物內建立了防禦陣地。

Key.Original: and they are using civilian buildings to fortify themselves.
Key.English: and they are using civilian buildings to fortify themselves.
Key.Chinese: ，他们正在使用民用建筑来加固自己。
Key.Chinese_Traditional: ，他們正在使用民用建築來加固自己。

Key.Original: You may also encounter technicals or soft vehicles.
Key.English: You may also encounter technicals or soft vehicles.
Key.Chinese: 您可能还会遇到技术车辆或软目标车辆。
Key.Chinese_Traditional: 您可能還會遇到技術車輛或軟目標車輛。

Key.Original: Be aware that there may be armored vehicles or even MBT's operating in the OP.
Key.English: Be aware that there may be armored vehicles or even MBT's operating in the OP.
Key.Chinese: 请注意，可能有装甲车辆甚至主战坦克在行动中。
Key.Chinese_Traditional: 請注意，可能有裝甲車輛甚至主戰坦克在行動中。

Key.Original: may also have artillery operating in the area.
Key.English: may also have artillery operating in the area.
Key.Chinese: 可能还有炮兵在该地区活动。
Key.Chinese_Traditional: 可能還有炮兵在該地區活動。

Key.Original: Go over your objectives, gear up and get ready. Mission is a go!
Key.English: Go over your objectives, gear up and get ready. Mission is a go!
Key.Chinese: 检查你的目标，装备好并准备就绪。任务开始！
Key.Chinese_Traditional: 檢查你的目標，裝備好並準備就緒。任務開始！

Key.Original: forces have established hasty checkpoints on some of the roads leading in and out of the area.
Key.English: forces have established hasty checkpoints on some of the roads leading in and out of the area.
Key.Chinese: 部队已在进出该地区的一些道路上建立了临时检查站。
Key.Chinese_Traditional: 部隊已在進出該地區的一些道路上建立了臨時檢查站。

Key.Original: Expect enemy reinforcements should they become aware of your presence.
Key.English: Expect enemy reinforcements should they become aware of your presence.
Key.Chinese: 如果他们察觉到你的存在，请期待敌军增援。
Key.Chinese_Traditional: 如果他們察覺到你的存在，請期待敵軍增援。

Key.Original: Keep an eye out for anything that might look suspicious, as we believe that may employ IEDs, or even suicide attacks.
Key.English: Keep an eye out for anything that might look suspicious, as we believe that may employ IEDs, or even suicide attacks.
Key.Chinese: 请留意任何可疑的东西，因为我们相信可能会使用简易爆炸装置，甚至自杀式袭击。
Key.Chinese_Traditional: 請留意任何可疑的東西，因為我們相信可能會使用簡易爆炸裝置，甚至自殺式襲擊。

Key.Original: The local civilians support, so be on the look out for any strange behavior. But keep civilian casualties to a minimum as the top Brass don't want to draw unnecessary attention.
Key.English: The local civilians support, so be on the look out for any strange behavior. But keep civilian casualties to a minimum as the top Brass don't want to draw unnecessary attention.
Key.Chinese: 当地平民支持，所以要留意任何奇怪的行为。但请将平民伤亡降到最低，因为高层不想引起不必要的注意。
Key.Chinese_Traditional: 當地平民支持，所以要留意任何奇怪的行為。但請將平民傷亡降到最低，因為高層不想引起不必要的注意。

Key.Chinese: 处理重生后的 addactions - 初始化。
